48530.question_text: Which of the following groups of animals do not possess a nervous system?
48530.explanation: Porifera are 'pore bearing' organisms, commonly known as sponges, are the only multicellular organisms without a nervous system. Their response to stimuli is by a contraction in their bodies.

48532.explanation: The plasmodium is a single-celled parasite that multiplies in red blood cells of humans as well as in the mosquito intestine. Hence, it doesn't live freely.

48560.question_text: Which of the following glands also serves as an exocrine gland?
